I have farmed in Kilimanjaro for many years, and on this large plot of nearly six hectares, I know that maize will not yield well without some fertilizer, so I buy what I can afford from the shop in town. I also spread manure from my animals because it keeps the soil strong, and I use improved seed that I got from the cooperative last season. At seventy-one, I cannot do all the digging and weeding alone, so my children and grandchildren work with me, but I still must hire laborers for the busiest times.
